description: Data add-on format 3. Each case is a whole data add-on: its input, every chunk file (its packed fields, and the file itself as hex), and lookups. Values are four counts in tag order: Fun, Skilled, Helpful, Leader. A reader loads every file of a case, then must answer every lookup: four counts, or nothing. Case 2 holds two exported keys that share a fingerprint and a known key that would borrow a value, and has empty chunks. Generated; never edit by hand.

cases.name: 40 bits, 16 chunks, shared fingerprints, empty chunks
